chapter_theme: The three releases: the soul's release, the release in the Supreme and the release in Siva, which are the state beyond, stilled calm and bliss. Souls that do not know what truly is go to birth, those who know go to grace, and release is to leave all and become one with Siva, who is attainment, release and samadhi.

2474.reading: Release of the soul is the state beyond, release in the Supreme is the stilled calm, release in Siva is bliss; these three releases of three forms dwell within Om, at the end of nada.
2474.nuance: அதீதம், உபசாந்தம், ஆனந்தம் name the three releases. தாரம் is taken as Om and நாதாந்தம் as the end of nada. Line 3 is printed with a stray letter.

2475.reading: Souls that do not know what truly is go to birth; souls that know it go to grace; seeing that nothing inside or outside is anything in itself, and leaving it, to become one with Siva beyond is release.
2475.nuance: ஆவது, 'what is' or 'what avails', opens three lines. ஓவு is cessation, and ஓவு சிவன் may be Siva who is the ceasing or Siva beyond.

2476.reading: To those who become Siva, destroying the three impurities and three gunas, and say 'I am he' on the path of union with the three releases, the stainless one, Siva, stands forth.
2476.nuance: சோகம் is so'ham, 'I am he'; it also means sorrow, but the context fixes the first sense. தவமான, which is tapas, may qualify the three releases or the path.

2477.reading: The great Lord who cut away bondage becomes attainment, release, the purity that is firm Siva, the Shakti of bliss that ends the three fires, and the highest samadhi.
2477.nuance: பெத்தம் (baddha) is the bound state, opposite of release. முத்தீ, three fires, are taken as the three impurities or the three torments; the ritual three fires are another reading.

links.note: Both trace birth to not knowing what truly is: the Kural to the delusion that takes the unreal as real, Tirumular to souls that do not know what is. Tirumular adds that those who know come to grace.

source_issues: 2474: line 3 begins with a stray 'Y' (Yமூவயின்), flagged as corrupt in the source.
